# REST operations

The 208 operations of the backend's OpenAPI schema, 26 of them contracted. Each unit serves the full schema at `/api/openapi.json` and an interactive view at `/api/docs`, where request and response models are described field by field. Request and response name the schema of the body (`untyped JSON` where it is untyped).

**Contracted** marks what Milo-Mac or Milo-iOS relies on: a change to it is listed under *API and integration changes* in the release notes. Everything else is **internal** and may change in any release. See [Integration](../integration.md#stability).
